_note: Registry MECHANICS are exercised for real (skopeo inspect, --config, and a genuine registry-to-registry copy into the cluster's own registry using the session token as credentials); registry POLICY is taught, because a training cluster has no Harbor with a scanner attached. The scan reports are fixtures in the shape Harbor's scanner produces, read with jq — the fields and the gate arithmetic are what transfer, and the lab says so where it matters. skopeo ships in dcs-workshop-base; there is no docker or podman anywhere, by design.

steps.run: envsubst < pod-from-registry.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc wait --for=condition=Ready pod/from-registry --timeout=240s
